name: week
title: This week in outbound
subtitle: Sales Sequences for Claude Code: what needs a person this week

sections.title: Compliance
sections.note: Checked against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Breaches first.
sections.sql: select severity, rule, code, who, finding from compliance_checks order by array_position(array['breach','due','check']::text[], severity), rule, code

sections.title: Replies nobody has answered
sections.sql: select prospect_code, prospect, account, owner, replied_on, outcome, note, days_waiting from replies_waiting order by days_waiting desc

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Overdue steps, holds, meetings, collisions, mailboxes and quiet accounts in one list.
sections.sql: select area, code, who, issue from attention order by array_position(array['replies','holds','meetings','tasks','collisions','mailboxes','quiet accounts']::text[], area), code

name: today
title: Today's queue
subtitle: Every step due, rep by rep, with anything on hold and why

sections.title: Due and overdue
sections.sql: select rep, enrolment, prospect, account, sequence_code, step, kind, due_on, days_late, coalesce(hold, '') as hold from task_queue order by rep, hold nulls first, days_late desc

sections.title: Mailbox load
sections.sql: select name as rep, daily_email_limit, sent_today, emails_due, over_by from mailbox_load order by over_by desc

name: sequences
title: Sequence results
subtitle: Which sequences and which steps earn replies and meetings

sections.title: By sequence
sections.sql: select code, name, enrolled, in_progress, replied, meetings, opted_out, bounced, reply_pct, meeting_pct from sequence_performance order by meeting_pct desc nulls last

sections.title: By step
sections.sql: select sequence_code, step, kind, what, sent, replies, positive, opt_outs from step_performance order by sequence_code, step

sections.title: Rep activity, last seven days
sections.sql: select name, emails, calls, connects, linkedin, replies, meetings_booked, due_now, overdue from rep_activity order by name
